description: A storage oscilloscope that records one stretch of a single input and holds it for inspection, storing up to 64 seconds even at 768kHz.

params.text: Sets how long a stretch is recorded, 1ms to 64 seconds.
Moves the view along the recording.
Moves the view up and down the recorded voltage range.

inputs.text: The signal recorded when the scope is triggered.
A gate or trigger pulse here starts a recording.

outputs.text: Sends a 1ms 10V pulse when a recording starts, whether it was started by the trigger input or by hand, so that several of these modules can record together.

notes: the display is empty until a recording is taken: send a gate or a trigger to the TRIGGER input, or press the STORE button.
over the display the pointer reports the voltage and the time under it, the sample number, and the stored voltage there; zoomed out it reports a range instead of one value.
menu: Match Cable Colors — draws the trace in the colour of the cable patched into the input.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.

inputs.1: high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only
